title: Measure Lot45 workflow and review redundancy
objective: Quantify redundant validation, workflow fan-out and quota-sensitive review coupling exposed by the Lot45 pilot, separate candidate-critical evidence from historical/noisy evidence, and produce a bounded consolidation plan without modifying workflows, Lot45 or business state.
non_goals: modify or delete GitHub Actions workflows
make Codex or another LLM mandatory
change runtime safety or execution permissions

required_invariants: analysis is bound to exact PR #66 head and current workflow-run evidence
candidate-critical failures are separated from historical fan-out failures
workflow duplication is measured before any deletion or consolidation proposal
semantic review requirements are provider-agnostic and never depend on a single LLM vendor or quota
substantive unresolved P1/P2 findings remain blockers regardless of review transport
no workflow or business code is changed in this AWU
BUSINESS remains PAUSED and Lot46 remains LOCKED
acceptance_criteria: all current PR-head workflows are classified by relevance and outcome
candidate-critical/global versus historical-fan-out failures are counted explicitly
repeated validation capabilities are mapped to candidate reusable/generic engine controls
review transport is separated from semantic review obligation
a concrete consolidation sequence is produced with expected workflow/noise reduction
repair actions are routed to a separate executable AWU rather than performed here

done_when: candidate-critical evidence remains fail-closed and clearly separated from historical noise
LLM-provider coupling is removed from future mandatory-process design
consolidation/remediation work is precisely routed to the next repair AWU
